title: Walter Turncoat Font
description: This resource pack makes your font look like the Walter Turncoat from Google Fonts
body:
**I recommend installing [Caxton](https://modrinth.com/mod/caxton) before using this pack because before I made this pack I already installed [Caxton](https://modrinth.com/mod/caxton) because I heard of it, and nobody has tested for me because they hate me so yeah install [Caxton](https://modrinth.com/mod/caxton) if it doesn't work** 🙏😔

-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
# Source
I took this font from [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/?preview.script=Latn). The font name is what you saw at the title, [Walter Turncoat](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Walter+Turncoat?preview.script=Latn&query=wal) 🐳

-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
# Feelings On Making This Pack
I never knew you could actually make font packs like this.. Just a TrueText Script, A MCDATA file, and a JSON and it's done! I took it straight out from Google AI Mode (which I'm still wondering if it's Gemini or nah) and I still have a lot of things I don't know about font pack making in Minecraft- Yes this will be a project that I might update overtime.. But please join the server I put on the Discord area so I can ask for suggestions please- I need this..

-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
